_comment: Freshness policy for the public cvm-registry dashboard. Single source of truth: the collector copies this object verbatim into site/catalog.json under 'policy', and the client reads it from there. Change the numbers here, rebuild, redeploy. ADR-0001 D6 is the rule this file implements.

link_check._comment: At collect time the collector sends ONE bound HEAD (GET on 405/501) to each service's DECLARED url — the `website` tag, else its first `r` link — and records the verdict as data on the cache. This is not a per-service CVM call and not a relay connection: the page still makes zero network requests (ADR-0001 D7). ok=true means 2xx/3xx; ok=false means it did not answer; ok=null means UNKNOWN (timeout, or the check did not run) and is never rendered as reachable. Disable with --no-link-check for offline/deterministic runs.

semantics.fresh: age <= fresh_ttl_seconds: announcements may be presented as current
semantics.stale: fresh_ttl_seconds < age <= max_age_seconds: entries are shown ONLY as an explicitly labelled cached snapshot; every live claim (freshness, refresh, 'current') is disabled
semantics.expired: age > max_age_seconds: the catalog is DISABLED and no entry is rendered
semantics.invalid: generated_at missing, unparseable, or future-dated beyond clock_skew_seconds: DISABLED (fail closed)
semantics.rule: stale must disable, never silently show old state as live (ADR-0001 D6)
